title: CT radiomics facilitates more accurate diagnosis of COVID-19 pneumonia: compared with CO-RADS
summary: In a retrospective cohort of 115 COVID-19 and 435 non-COVID pneumonia patients, the combined model reported a validation AUC of 0.98. The retrospective single-study result needs external evaluation and does not establish performance in other populations or scanners.
ai_technology: CT radiomics features were combined with clinical variables to classify COVID-19 pneumonia against other pneumonia, with comparison to CO-RADS.
